title: Pizza Stone Dough
steps: Mix the flour and water without the salt and yeast until combined; if using a stand mixer, mix on its lowest setting for 2 minutes. Rest 20 minutes.
Add salt and yeast. Mix on low to medium speed for 5 minutes or knead by hand for 6–8 minutes, until the sticky dough just forms a ball.
Turn onto a lightly floured surface, knead briefly, fold into thirds and seal. Rotate, bring the ends together and seal again, placing seam-side down.
Place in a lightly oiled bowl, cover and rise for 90 minutes to 2 hours, until doubled.
Gently turn out and divide into desired portions; the source suggests three approximately 275 g balls for 12-inch pizzas. Shape and cover the balls, and proof at least 1 hour before shaping.
Alternatively, shape the balls without the room-temperature bulk rise and refrigerate in a covered container for a day or two. Remove about 1 hour before use.
